releases.name: Europe
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus
releases.note: The same levels as the North American release, at 25 frames a second. The gas countdowns still count frames by 30, so one of 7200 frames shows 240 seconds and lasts 288.

releases.name: France
releases.title: Oddworld: L'Exode d'Abe
releases.note: French text on the signs and screens, over the North American release's levels with one wall in Mudomo Vault moved, at 25 frames a second. The gas countdowns still count frames by 30, so one of 7200 frames shows 240 seconds and lasts 288.

releases.name: Germany
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus
releases.note: German text on the signs and screens, over the North American release's levels with one wall in Mudomo Vault moved, at 25 frames a second. The gas countdowns still count frames by 30, so one of 7200 frames shows 240 seconds and lasts 288.

releases.name: Japan
releases.title: Abe '99
releases.note: Japanese text on the signs and screens, and fixes the North American release lacks: floors added in Necrum Mines, gas countdowns in the Brewery's return, and doors and switches reworked in FeeCo and Bonewerkz.

releases.name: USA, first pressing
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
releases.note: The levels as first pressed, before Rev 1 revised them: a few collision lines and 28 objects set otherwise, the Scrabania map and a Paramonia screen as first drawn, and the background Glukkons and chanting Mudokons as first animated.

releases.name: USA, Rev 1
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
releases.note: Rev 2's levels and screens, without the two Exoddus promo screens on its menu.

releases.name: Europe
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
releases.note: Hundreds of collision lines and dozens of objects reworked, a few screens and foregrounds redrawn, and 25 frames a second.

releases.name: France
releases.title: Oddworld: L'Odyssée d'Abe
releases.note: French text on the signs and screens, over the levels as first pressed, before Rev 1 revised them, and 25 frames a second.

releases.name: Germany
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
releases.note: German text on the signs and screens, over the levels as first pressed, before Rev 1 revised them, with one security claw in Rupture Farms Return moved, and 25 frames a second.

releases.name: Italy
releases.title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
releases.note: Italian text on the signs and screens, over the levels as first pressed with some of Rev 1's revisions, and 25 frames a second.

releases.name: Japan
releases.title: Abe a GoGo
releases.note: Japanese text on the signs and screens and the hand prints on the stones redrawn, over Rev 2's levels.
